verdict.rationale: Google Drive's REST API covers most core UI actions—upload/download, create/organize files, sharing & permissions, search/listing, custom metadata, and change notifications—giving broad functional parity with the UI (google-drive-docs-5,7,9,10,11,20,25). However, there's no explicit vendor claim of full UI-API parity, and probes for machine-readable API discovery (llms.txt, openapi.json) both failed, suggesting some UI-only conveniences (e.g., OCR search integration, sharing UI nuances, storage/plan management) aren't clearly API-exposed. Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation, evidence for API access to OCR/search-within-scans, comments/collaboration UI features, and machine-readable spec discoverability.
